Short lines: sequence · hover a quest: other prerequisites
Open a quest to inspect all prerequisites. Its map role does not change its completion conditions.

quest.5130110539E774E4.quest_desc: Prepare experience, lapis lazuli and the item to enchant. Nearby shelves change the table’s capabilities; the Apothic Enchanting interface shows its actual parameters.
Start with useful mining and protection enchantments. Then use the Apotheosis chapter to learn Eterna, Quanta and Arcana, library storage and transferring enchantments to the right equipment.
quest.5130110539E774E4.title: Obtain 1 × Enchanting Table
quest.513011183B7E03D8.quest_desc: A bucket moves fluid sources for your first machines. Keep a separate supply for water and fuel so each new recipe does not require dismantling a working setup.
Many machine interfaces use a bucket slot to fill or drain a tank. Check where the empty container ends up and recover it for the next operation.
quest.513011183B7E03D8.title: Obtain 1 × Bucket
quest.513011209CCD8C68.quest_desc: An iron pickaxe is needed for diamonds and many later ores. Split the first diamonds between tool development and campaign recipes; avoid spending the entire supply on spare equipment.
When moving to Modern Foundry, improve an assembled pickaxe with a new head or the appropriate modifier. Chapter 02 explains assembly and repair.
quest.513011209CCD8C68.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Pickaxe
quest.51301127D0A2834C.quest_desc: A smithing table uses a smithing template, base item and added material. A vanilla netherite upgrade needs a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template, diamond equipment and a netherite ingot.
Check the output carefully: armour trimming and upgrading its material are different recipes. Modern Foundry’s Netherite modifier follows that workshop’s own rules.
quest.51301127D0A2834C.title: Obtain 1 × Smithing Table
quest.51301129D6E9E5E6.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Sword (minecraft:iron_sword). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301129D6E9E5E6.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Sword
quest.513011350308FBB4.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Axe (minecraft:iron_axe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011350308FBB4.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Axe
quest.51301165EB39C7C7.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Brewing Stand (minecraft:brewing_stand). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301165EB39C7C7.title: Obtain 1 × Brewing Stand
quest.51301166893DC2DA.quest_desc: Place the crafting table beside your wood and stone supply. Its 3×3 grid makes tools, a furnace and the first workshop components. Leave room for a chest and later material delivery.
Prepare a pickaxe, torches, food and a spare tool before leaving the base. This quest detects the table in your inventory; place it and make the supplies after that check.
quest.51301166893DC2DA.title: Obtain 1 × Crafting Table
quest.5130116F7BAEEFCD.quest_desc: Equip the shield in your offhand and practise blocking before an expedition. Face the incoming attack; the shield does not cover every direction at once.
Keep food and a retreat route available. Read the relevant chapter before fighting modded bosses: a shield alone does not replace the required equipment and arena preparation.
quest.5130116F7BAEEFCD.title: Obtain 1 × Shield
quest.51301176F3997CB9.quest_desc: The hopper recipe uses 5 iron ingots, 1 ordinary wooden chest and 1 unused Sophisticated Storage Basic to Iron Tier Upgrade. That upgrade includes the copper and iron tiers; chapter 37 explains its crafting. The recipe consumes a separate upgrade item, so you do not need to empty an installed storage chest.
A hopper pulls items from the inventory above it and sends them towards its spout. Sneak while placing it against the target face of a chest or machine.
Start with a one-item test and inspect the output. If transfer stops, check orientation, the machine’s side rules, free space and any redstone signal locking the hopper.
quest.51301176F3997CB9.title: Obtain 1 × Hopper
quest.51301192168BC828.quest_desc: Activate an empty map in the area you want to explore and fill it as you travel. Also mark the base coordinates and important dungeon entrances on the pack’s map.
Prepare inventory space and a return method for each expedition. Revealed terrain helps plan a route, but a map does not complete visit objectives in place of the player.
quest.51301192168BC828.title: Obtain 1 × Map
quest.5130119BCB4A0B6B.quest_desc: A grindstone removes ordinary enchantments from unwanted equipment and returns some experience. Make sure you do not want to preserve those enchantments for another item first.

Develop the enchantment-extraction branch when you want to move an enchantment onto a book. A grindstone does not replace the Enchantment Extractor, and disenchanting is separate from Apotheosis affix reforging.
quest.5130119BCB4A0B6B.title: Obtain 1 × Grindstone
quest.5130119BE787F5B6.quest_desc: Bookshelves support the enchanting table. Place them within its valid area and check the interface after changing the arrangement.
The pack provides specialised shelves with different properties for advanced enchanting. Counting ordinary shelves alone does not describe the resulting setup; continue in the Apotheosis chapter.
quest.5130119BE787F5B6.title: Obtain 1 × Bookshelf
quest.5130119EF6D73D82.quest_desc: An anvil combines compatible equipment and enchanted books for experience. Check the resulting item, enchantment compatibility and displayed cost before confirming.
Choose the enchantments your working tool needs first. Modern Foundry’s modular tools use their own station and modifiers; the foundry chapter explains repairs with the head material.
quest.5130119EF6D73D82.title: Obtain 1 × Anvil
quest.513011A41D3B7A48.quest_desc: Prepare an accessible water source beside the workshop and a spare bucket for travel. Water supports early recipes, some machines and terrain preparation.
A water bucket does not establish a continuous machine supply. For uninterrupted production, check the connection, transfer direction and tank level while the machine runs.
quest.513011A41D3B7A48.title: Obtain 1 × Water Bucket
quest.513011B28366CA37.quest_desc: A dropper sends items into the inventory in front of it or ejects them into the world on a redstone pulse. Use it when you want a controlled delivery.
Test one pulse and check where the item goes. If the item itself must act, such as firing an arrow, use the dispenser from the next quest.
quest.513011B28366CA37.title: Obtain 1 × Dropper
quest.513011C110B2ACF5.quest_desc: A stone pickaxe lets you begin mining iron. Bring the first ore home, smelt it and prepare an iron tool before searching for more valuable resources.
Check the mining requirement in an unfamiliar ore’s tooltip before breaking it. Upgrade the pickaxe first if its mining tier is insufficient.
quest.513011C110B2ACF5.title: Obtain 1 × Stone Pickaxe
quest.513011E3C2DBDC24.quest_desc: Light the workshop, approaches to the base and your mining route. Carry extra coal or charcoal and sticks to replenish torches during a long trip.

Mark junctions consistently, for example by placing torches on one side of the passage. Light helps navigation, while structures, spawners and special modded creatures still need their own precautions.
quest.513011E3C2DBDC24.title: Obtain 1 × Torch
quest.513011EC69FFD72C.quest_desc: In this pack, the ordinary furnace needs 8 cobblestone or other accepted stone crafting blocks around 1 ordinary wooden chest. Prepare the chest before crafting the furnace.
Put raw material in the upper furnace slot, fuel below it, and collect the result on the right. Start with iron for a bucket, shield and your next pickaxe.
Keep a separate fuel supply for metallurgy. The ordinary furnace prepares basic materials; steel, infused alloys and molten fluids later need the machines taught in the industry chapters.
quest.513011EC69FFD72C.title: Obtain 1 × Furnace
quest.513011EE880E028A.quest_desc: A dispenser responds to a redstone pulse by using supported items in front of it. For an initial test, load one arrow and leave clear space ahead.
Its action depends on the contents, so test the intended item before integrating it into a machine. A dropper or hopper is simpler for ordinary chest delivery.
quest.513011EE880E028A.title: Obtain 1 × Dispenser
quest.513011F155DE22C0.quest_desc: An ordinary compass points towards world spawn in the Overworld. Mark your base separately on the map if you build far from that location.
Record the portal coordinates and return route before entering another dimension. Carrying a compass neither creates a return portal nor automatically points to your last bed.
quest.513011F155DE22C0.title: Obtain 1 × Compass
quest.513011F253F82E4C.quest_desc: Give building blocks, ores and ingots, food and trophies clear storage locations. Reserve components for the next milestone in a separate chest so side projects do not spend them by accident.
Unload after each expedition. Free inventory space and a spare kit at the base are more useful than another unsorted overflowing chest.
quest.513011F253F82E4C.title: Obtain 1 × Chest
quest.513011FCE4A56F3F.quest_desc: Use a spyglass to inspect a distant structure, slime island or descent before approaching it. Check the height, access and a safe route back.
Looking from a distance does not complete a structure-visit quest. Read the objective and enter the required area yourself when a visit is requested.
quest.513011FCE4A56F3F.title: Obtain 1 × Spyglass
quest.514D010000000001.quest_desc: Start with the Base Foundation, then use the first chapter, 00 · Main Route, to find your next shared goal. Six material milestones connect industry, magic and expeditions.

Your first goal is Industrial Chassis. In chapter 03, build a Coke Oven: its coke fuels the Blast Furnace for steel, and its creosote makes treated planks. Add copper wire coils and an iron component. After the chassis, Mekanism and Ender IO alloys plus AE2 processors lead to Precision Mechanism and the first ME autocrafting setup.

Botania, Aether and Twilight Forest lead to Dimensional Matrix; the Moon and Eden to Stellar Alloy; Mortum, Gaia and Ultimate circuits to Mythic Circuit; antimatter and Calorite to EMC Core. Optional expeditions and collections use circles.

Read production sections from top to bottom. Short lines show local sequences; hover or open a quest to inspect its other prerequisites. Large hexagons on Main Route are material milestones, while circles mark optional objectives. Subtitles name the actual topic or the item's purpose.

A multiblock's Tasks tab lists the blocks for its smallest described construction. Hold them before building: detection does not consume items. A separate formation or operation condition, where present, verifies the finished machine. Three engineering tasks are explicitly manual confirmations after your own system test.

Book controls: right-click the Quest Book, or bind Open Quests under Controls → FTB Quests. Hover an item and press R for recipes or U for uses. JEI in the installed pack contains the current recipes.

Every member claims each quest reward personally once. A pack performs 3–5 draws, increasing as the team produces its material milestones. Repeated resources combine; each identical unstackable item is delivered at most once per pack. Backpacks, boats, rafts and Masa are excluded from rewards. When the theme has unlocked better prizes, one draw guarantees an uncommon-or-better prize. Expensive components enter their pools only after actual production of that same item; gifts and rewards do not count as manufacturing evidence.

Selected expensive crafts also return part of their consumed components. Guaranteed items appear as separate counted icons beside the pack or cube. The View Rewards button and Ctrl+Shift+V show every possible pack prize, its rarity and unlock conditions. A preview does not claim a reward: use the original pack or cube button to receive the complete bundle. The refund requires actual manufacture of the output by you or your current team; an early claim attempt does not consume your entitlement.

Completed production chains, important structures and adventure goals award Mayhem Cubes. Open them in a separate test area away from the base. Use /soqm rewards to see your reward level, and /soqm rewards pool <theme> for eligible prizes, normal and guaranteed-draw odds, and conditions on locked items.
quest.514D010000000001.title: Start the Campaign
quest.514D010000000002.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 32 × Oak Log (minecraft:oak_log). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 64 × Cobblestone (minecraft:cobblestone). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 16 × Iron Ingot (minecraft:iron_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514D010000000002.title: Obtain 32 × Oak Log + Obtain 64 × Cobblestone + More
quest.514D010000000003.quest_desc: Assemble a valid Modern Foundry pickaxe and use it to successfully break an ordinary Stone block. Its material combination can vary. A stored pickaxe, a hit without breaking and a protected failed attempt do not count. Consult Materials and You for the installed version's assembly and material rules.
quest.514D010000000003.title: Put a Modular Pickaxe to Work
quest.514D010000000004.quest_desc: Power a Mekanism electric machine such as an Energized Smelter, Enrichment Chamber or Crusher and finish at least one actual recipe. Remain within 16 blocks when it finishes. A charged empty machine or blocked output is insufficient.
quest.514D010000000004.title: Complete a Powered Machine Recipe
quest.514D010000000005.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 32 × Iron Ingot (minecraft:iron_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.

Produce a cumulative 32 iron ingots in a Mekanism Energized Smelter. Stay within 16 blocks when operations finish. The team machine counter persists between sessions. The separate item task also requires 32 ingots in your inventory without consumption; inventory presence and machine production are distinct checks.
quest.514D010000000005.title: Smelt 32 Iron Ingots with Power
quest.514D010000000006.quest_desc: Manually confirm: feed raw materials from storage into a machine and automatically move its output into other storage. Observe a complete batch producing 32 iron ingots without hand transfers between operations. Compatible transport from any installed mod is allowed. This checkmark does not detect pipes, machines or containers.
quest.514D010000000006.title: Production without Hand Transfers
quest.514D010000000007.quest_desc: Optional branch: find a real Millénaire settlement and complete one successful exchange through its own trading interface.

Only an accepted sale or purchase counts. Opening the window, a failed request or trading with a vanilla villager does not qualify. Right-click its trader without sneaking and choose an available exchange.

If the settlement is far away, continue production and the introductory route. This branch and its following supply task do not block the introduction summary. Check Controls → Millénaire for its information panel and village-list bindings.
quest.514D010000000007.title: A Successful Millénaire Trade
quest.514D010000000008.quest_desc: After the first exchange, check Millénaire demand and sell or donate a total of 64 accepted building-material units. Logs, planks, stone, cobblestone, stone bricks, sand, glass, clay, bricks and corresponding building blocks can qualify.
Only accepted units count: returned excess, purchases, food, seeds and money do not advance the counter. Progress accumulates for the team between sessions.
This is optional settlement support with a personal quest reward. It unlocks and blocks no later quest; the introduction summary can be completed without locating a settlement.
quest.514D010000000008.title: Supply a Settlement
quest.514D010000000009.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Realmite Ingot (divinerpg:realmite_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.514D010000000009.quest_subtitle: Magic, adventure and the next step
quest.514D010000000009.title: Obtain 1 × Realmite Ingot
quest.514D01000000000A.quest_subtitle: Magic, adventure and the next step
quest.514D01000000000A.title: Defeat 5 × Cave Crawler
quest.514D01000000000B.quest_desc: Build mana generation, transfer and a normal Botania Revived Mana Pool. Once it contains mana, right-click the pool. The automatic check requires real mana greater than zero; an empty pool or Creative Mana Pool does not qualify.
quest.514D01000000000B.quest_subtitle: Magic, adventure and the next step
quest.514D01000000000B.title: Mana at the Base
quest.514D01000000000C.quest_desc: Complete three introductory routes: automatic production, DivineRPG hunting and first mana. Millénaire trading and supply remain a separate optional branch.
The summary completes automatically from those three quest dependencies. Finding a settlement, a particular structure or a biome is not one of its conditions.

Every member claims one cube for this quest. Open cubes in a separate area away from the base: their pools include dangerous events and structures. Choose the next chapter according to your production goal.
quest.514D01000000000C.quest_subtitle: Magic, adventure and the next step
quest.514D01000000000C.title: Ready for Greater Expeditions
